description: Flood Study — Citywide Overland Flow — Airport Sub-Model is a dataset listed in Brisbane Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Brisbane City Council. Brisbane City Council Citywide Creek and Overland Flow Path Mapping Flood Study Airport Sub-Model. This dataset contains reports, data and metadata used in the flood study, and results data for the existing floodplain condition scenarios. Council is committed to ensuring we have the latest flood modelling data to help manage flood risk in Brisbane. Coverage: Brisbane, Queensland. The portal files it under Environment. Its keywords are catchment, flood, flood map, flood study, overland, overland flow. The portal shows 19 records. The portal shows 2024-06-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-brisbane-qld-gov-au-portal.
